image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), resting on a green leaf. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is uniformly brown with distinct rows of small eyespots (ocelli) featuring white centers and black rings. The body is slender, hairy, and brown. One clubbed antenna is clearly visible. The background consists of blurred green foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wing color is consistent brown/tan. Multiple ocelli are visible in two distinct rows on the hindwing and forewing, matching the description perfectly.

To check for edge bleeding between the complex wing edges and the leaf background, and ensure wing veins/patterns are topologically consistent.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the wing scales or leaf surface that might indicate AI generation artifacts.
To verify the physical contact point between the legs and the leaf, ensuring no floating or grounding errors.

Edge sharpness between wing margins and background

Texture realism of wing scales vs leaf veins
